module.purpose: Implements QueryObserver, a reactive subscriber that observes a Query, computes results (including placeholder data, selectors, optimistic reads), manages stale/refetch timers, and notifies listeners on changes. Core reactivity primitive of the query-core package.
module.summary: This file defines the QueryObserver class which bridges a Query instance and consumer components. It subscribes to query state changes, derives a normalized result object (handling status, fetchStatus, stale, placeholder, select transformations), and pushes updates to listeners through notifyManager. It manages refetch-on-mount, window focus, reconnect, stale timeouts, and refetch intervals using timeoutManager and environment/focus managers. It supports optimistic result computation for suspense and concurrent rendering, tracking accessed properties to optimize notifications. Several module-level helper functions decide when to fetch based on enabled, stale, and retry options.
module.businessContext: Part of TanStack Query core data-fetching library. Enables UI to reactively reflect server state. If broken, components stall, never refetch, or show stale/incorrect data.

constructor(
    client: QueryClient,
    public options: QueryObserverOptions<
      TQueryFnData,
      TError,
      TData,
      TQueryData,
      TQueryKey
    >,
  ) {
    super()

    this.#client = client
    this.#selectError = null
    this.#currentThenable = pendingThenable()

    this.bindMethods()
    this.setOptions(options)
  }
